subject: Call recap — SOC 2 scope, retention alignment & artifact handoff
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Leah Tran <ltran@maplefin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Maple Financial Security <security@maplefin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 May 2028 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Call recap — SOC 2 scope, retention alignment & artifact handoff

Hi Leah,

Thanks again for the call today — good to meet you and the Maple team. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps. I pulled together owners on our side (cc'd) so we can move as efficiently as possible.

Key constraints you shared
- SOC 2: must be in-scope for both Production and Customer Data export endpoints (controls mapped to CC and common criteria).
- Audit logs: retention requirement is 5 years for financial transaction logs, 1 year for access logs; exportable on demand for audits.
- DPA: Maple requires a security-focused DPA with retention and subprocessors spelled out; most changes will be small redlines but we expect to iterate.
- Pen test: you require a third-party pen test or red team report within the last 12 months; if we can surface a recent vendor report that covers the infra footprint, that will speed acceptance.

Primary goals we noted
- Confirm SOC 2 status and provide a high-level scope summary and any bridge letter for the current audit cycle.
- Share an example audit log export and schema so your team can validate evidence ingestion.
- Provide a DPA draft with our standard retention clauses and a short timeline for negotiation.
- Supply pen test evidence or statement of the most recent third-party test and remediation tracking.

Immediate asks / owners
- Kimberly (me): produce SOC 2 summary and bridge note + proposed DPA redline (ETA: EOD Thursday, 2028-05-18).
- Neha (cc): collect and sanitize an audit_log_sample.csv (ETA: Wednesday morning, 2028-05-17).
- Ben (cc): pull pen-test report summary and vendor contact for transfer to Maple's audit vendor (ETA: Wednesday EOD).

Suggested mutual action plan (MAP)
1) We drop the SOC 2 summary, DPA draft, and a sample audit export into the shared Drive by 2028-05-18.
2) Maple confirms the retention buckets and whether 5 years for transaction logs is a hard requirement or negotiable.
3) If Maple's auditor needs additional proof (e.g., raw logs), we schedule a short technical sync the following week.

Attachments I intend to share: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, audit_log_sample.csv (sanitized), DPA_Redline_v1.docx

Next call? If helpful we can do a 30-min technical handoff once you’ve had a chance to review the artifacts — propose Tue 5/23 or Wed 5/24.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Leah Tran <ltran@maplefin.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Maple Financial Security <security@maplefin.com>
Date: Wed, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call recap — SOC 2 scope, retention alignment & artifact handoff

Kim,

Appreciate the write-up — this captures our ask nicely. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Transaction logs at 5 years are our preference for regulatory audits, but we can treat that as a negotiable requirement if you can surface compensating controls for older records.
- Access logs must be retrievable as raw exports for at least 12 months; longer-term aggregated metrics are acceptable for anything beyond that.

I've attached an initial intake spreadsheet we use for evidence intake — it's not exhaustive but will help your team map artifacts to our checklist.

We can meet Tue 5/23 11:00 PT for the technical handoff; tentatively booked pending your confirmation.

Thanks,
Leah

Attachments: Maple_Evidence_Intake_Template.xlsx (stub)

--
Leah Tran
Head of Vendor Risk, Maple Financial
ltran@maplefin.com | +1 212-555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Leah Tran <ltran@maplefin.com>
Date: Wed, 17 May 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Call recap — SOC 2 scope, retention alignment & artifact handoff

On Wed, May 17, 2028 at 09:12 AM Leah Tran <ltran@maplefin.com> wrote:
> Kim,
>
> Appreciate the write-up — this captures our ask nicely.

Thanks — quick internal note on owners and the artifacts Leah requested.

Action items for Redwood ops/security
- I will produce a sanitized audit_log_sample.csv (fields: timestamp,event_type,user_id,resource_id,request_id) and a short README explaining what each column represents. Will remove any PII and truncate IDs. ETA: 2028-05-17 16:00 PT.
- Ben: can you confirm the most recent third-party pen test vendor and whether we have a non-confidential executive summary we can share with Maple? If the report includes sensitive finding details we can provide a redacted executive summary + remediation timeline.
- Kimberly: I’ll also prepare a short note that maps our SOC 2 scope to the high-level controls Maple listed.

Ben — can you own the vendor outreach? Please loop in Crownsys if you need a provenance statement.

Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Leah Tran <ltran@maplefin.com>, Maple Financial Security <security@maplefin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Delivery: SOC 2 summary, sample audit log & DPA redline (initial)

Leah / Maple team,

Per our MAP, attached are the initial artifacts for your intake team to review:
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary of scope, last audit period, and bridge items)
- audit_log_sample.csv (sanitized sample export + README)
- DPA_Redline_v1.docx (our standard redline focused on retention and subprocessors)

Links:
- Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-maple-infosec
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/54321

Open items to confirm
1) Transaction log retention: please confirm whether 5 years will be a hard requirement. If so, Neha will propose an acceptable retention SLA and a mapping of storage/backups that satisfies the ask.
2) Pen test artifacts: Ben is coordinating with Crownsys to determine whether we can share an executive summary or a vendor attestation. Ben will update by EOD 5/18.

Next steps
- Leah: please review the artifacts and mark any gaps in the Maple_Evidence_Intake_Template.
- We’ll meet Tue 5/23 11:00 PT for the technical handoff (calendar invite sent).

If you need anything sooner, reply here and we’ll triage.

Thanks — Kim

Attachments (stubs): redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, audit_log_sample.csv, DPA_Redline_v1.docx

--
